newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's ASX, SFE to extend trading hours.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's ASX, SFE to extend trading hours.

text.p: The Australian Stock Exchange (ASX) said it will extend the close of its trading hours to 4.15 p.m. (0515 GMT) from 4.00 p.m. (0500 GMT), effective February 10.

The ASX said the extended trading hours, to run from 10.00 a.m. (2300 GMT) to 4.15 p.m., were being introduced to meet the needs of institutional investors which had sought greater trading flexibility for large blocks of securities.
The extended trading hours will operate as follows:
At 4.00 p.m., the Stock Exhange Automated Trading System (SEATS) will move to pre-open mode from normal trading mode.
When in pre-open mode from 4.00 p.m., new orders can be entered, existing orders can be amended or cancelled but no executions of trades can occur.
At 4.15 p.m., the market will open using the Initial Price Offer SEATS algorithm to match out all overlapping bids and offers at a single price.
Trades resulting from this action will adjust high, low and last prices and the calculation of the share price indices.
Closing levels for prices, and the indices, will thus be as at 4.15 p.m., once all overlapping trades have been executed and the indices updated.

As a result of the extended trading hours on the ASX, the Sydney Futures Exchange said it would extend floor trading for share price index futures and individual share futures by 10 minutes until 4.25 p.m. (0525 GMT).
